inputs.<tmp:0>/projects/shop/.brigade/worktrees:
SCHEMA TASK
	DESC "a change delivered by one pull request"
	FIELD TITLE string
		REQUIRED
	FIELD STATUS todo|implemented
		REQUIRED
	FIELD MILESTONE @MILESTONE
	FIELD SPEC string
		REPEATABLE
		FIELD IMPL anchor
			REPEATABLE

SCHEMA MILESTONE
	DESC "the tasks planned for one request"
	FIELD TITLE string
		REQUIRED
	FIELD STATUS planned|running
		REQUIRED

SCHEMA RECIPE
	DESC "a kind of work brigade runs as ordered steps; its name is the name of the recipe"
	FIELD SCHEMA_VERSION uint
		REQUIRED
	FIELD MAX_WALL uint
		REQUIRED
	FIELD STEP command
		REQUIRED
		REPEATABLE
		FIELD ARGV string
			REPEATABLE

MILESTONE M1
	TITLE "Empty cart"
	STATUS running

RECIPE acceptance
	SCHEMA_VERSION 1
	MAX_WALL 10
	STEP command
		ARGV "python3"
		ARGV "--version"

TASK S2
	TITLE "Remove an item from the cart"
	STATUS implemented

TASK S3
	TITLE "Empty the cart in one click"
	STATUS todo
	MILESTONE @MILESTONE.M1
	SPEC "the button of src/cart/button.py, once pressed, empties the cart"
	SPEC "the emptying charges nothing"

TASK S6
	TITLE "Count the emptied carts"
	STATUS todo
	MILESTONE @MILESTONE.M1
